name: A3 Ultra
summary:
A3 Ultra is a full-size AgiBot humanoid aimed at commercial interaction, guided services and robotics development. The manufacturer lists a height of 174 cm and combines lidar-based surrounding perception with substantial onboard computing. Its service features include customizable voice and appearance, allowing operators to adapt the robot to a venue or brand.

Power management includes autonomous plug-in charging and a rapid battery-replacement workflow. AgiBot's advertised runtime is tied to a specified mixture of walking and standing, so it should not be treated as a continuous heavy-work

description.en:
A3 Ultra is a full-size AgiBot humanoid aimed at commercial interaction, guided services and robotics development. The manufacturer lists a height of 174 cm and combines lidar-based surrounding perception with substantial onboard computing. Its service features include customizable voice and appearance, allowing operators to adapt the robot to a venue or brand.

Power management includes autonomous plug-in charging and a rapid battery-replacement workflow. AgiBot's advertised runtime is tied to a specified mixture of walking and standing, so it should not be treated as a continuous heavy-work rating. Developer and education configurations offer SDK and ROS 2 access for integrating sensing, motion and application software.
